title: 云鲸初航

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：单人白犬、可见包袱结、木码头完整延伸到底部，天空弧形航道和远处鲸形云岛可辨；只作执行者母版选定，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque tarot card master illustration, vertical 2:3 (1024x1536), for The Fool, theme 云鲸初航 / Cloud Whale First Voyage. Use the attached original card only as identity and visual-language reference: one youthful traveler with windblown dark hair, ivory shirt, flowing deep blue-violet cloak, a shoulder staff carrying a visibly tied small bundle, and exactly one alert white dog. Preserve elegant painterly fantasy tarot quality and restrained thin celestial gold border, but invent a clearly new scene. At lower left, traveler and dog stand safely together on a broad wooden sky harbor dock above a vast cream-white cloud sea, both looking toward a curving aerial route that sweeps to the upper right. The dock must show continuous full-width planks, strong outer edge and structural thickness extending into the bottom bleed; paws and boots visibly contact it. A whale-shaped cloud island is far in the distance only, never a second creature near the characters. Sky cyan, warm cream, peach gold sunrise, distinct deep blue clothing. Strong near/mid/far depth and clean silhouette for later layering. Staff stays behind the head, not through it; the bundle knot is visible; show all four dog legs clearly. One traveler and one dog only. No lettering, labels, logo, watermark, additional people, duplicate dog, floating body parts, cropped feet or narrow floating support. Rich hand-painted illustration, fine engraved accents, atmospheric light, refined tarot composition.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.
